postings.title: AI & Automation Intern, Communications (Winter 2027)
postings.description:
About Us
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations: 
Austin, TX
San Francisco, CA
Available Term
Winter (January - April 2027) 
About the role
Cloudflare’s mission is to help build a better Internet—and our Communications team is responsible for telling that story to the world and to our own employees. Across Public Relations, Social, Internal, Visual, and Executive Communications, we support major company announcements, Innovation Weeks, internal employee platforms and news, our public social channels and executive communications.
Cloudflare moves fast, and so does our work. We're looking for a builder who is just as curious about how organizations communicate as about the technology behind it. You might be studying information science, data science, HCI, digital media, journalism, cognitive science, business or information systems, or communications with a strong technical streak, or coming from a coding bootcamp or self-taught path. You'll work at the intersection of AI, automation, and employee and corporate communications, identifying opportunities to eliminate manual work, connect disconnected systems, and build tools that make our team smarter and more effective.
By the end of the internship, you’ve built new tools or processes for how we can better communicate or collaborate. 
Responsibilities
Automate the everyday: Build workflows that can save the team time—like creating a dynamic, shared visual calendar that pulls milestones automatically from multiple team trackers, auto-populating our weekly internal newsletter with top press coverage, or keeping our internal wiki (Company Hub) continuously updated with the latest stats or coverage highlights.
Own a flagship AI project: Sit down with teammates across PR, Social, Design, and Internal Comms to uncover an opportunity to use AI to reimagine a time-consuming or fragmented process. Own the process from discovery through prototyping, testing, and deployment.
Improve AI knowledge and retrieval: Partner with Communications and the Agentic Solutions Team to improve how internal AI tools access, organize, and retrieve information and share with employees. Help identify gaps in existing knowledge sources, improve content quality and structure, and test the accuracy and usefulness of AI-generated responses.
Share what you build: Teach the team how to use the tools you build and share and learn from other interns and teams across the company. Present flagship AI project during company-wide intern presentations.
Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:
Technical foundation: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a field such as information science, data science, human-computer interaction, digital media, business or information systems, journalism, communications, or a related technical field.
AI enthusiast: Experience building with AI tools, including LLMs, AI agents, or AI-assisted development tools.
Systems thinker: Experience working with APIs, webhooks, or integrating different systems.
Hands-on problem solver: You enjoy uncovering problems and figuring out how to solve them. You’re not afraid to ask for help or proactively reach out to others across the company to get answers.
Availability: Ability to commit to a full-time (40 hours/week Monday - Friday) for a minimum 12 week internship, with 3-5 days in office.
Understands the value of communications: Recognizes how effective communications improves engagement, connection, and alignment. You don't need a communications background, but you're interested in how technology can improve the way organizations communicate.
Compensation
Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.
For San Francisco Bay Area based hires: Estimated hourly rate of $27.00/hr.
What Makes Cloudflare Special?
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!
Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.
This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.
Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.
Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

postings.title: Intern, Futureforce University Recruiting
postings.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.
About Futureforce University Recruiting
Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more.
Job Category
Fixed Term & Temporary
Job Details
About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
Location: Paris, France
Contract Type: 6-Month Internship
Start Date: February 2027
Language Requirement: Fluent in English & French (written & verbal mandatory)
About Futureforce
Futureforce is Salesforce’s global university recruitment program dedicated to attracting, retaining, and cultivating next-generation talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real-world projects that impact how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible difference on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits collaborate and connect on a truly global scale.
We are seeking a proactive, highly organised, and customer-centric University Recruiting Intern to join our team for 6 months starting in February 2027 . In this role, you will support the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle for our apprentice and graduate programs, champion our employer brand across key universities, uphold administrative and legal compliance, and leverage innovative AI tools to optimize our workflows.
Your Impact
Apprentice & Graduate Hiring: Support the full-cycle recruitment of apprentices and graduates across various business units.
Partner with recruiters to review applications, conduct initial screening interviews, and coordinate assessment centres.
Act as an advocate for candidates, providing thoughtful preparation, clear communication, and a standout candidate experience.
Campus Engagement & Employer Branding: Coordinate and participate in on-campus and virtual recruitment events
Administrative Compliance & Operations: Guarantee end-to-end administrative compliance for hires, managing the apprentice agreements process (CERFA/contracts), OPCO submissions, and mandatory onboarding paperwork.
Ensure operational rigor, tracking accuracy, and data integrity in our internal HR systems and tools.
AI Fluency & Process Innovation: Champion AI-powered productivity: embrace internal and emerging generative AI tools to streamline sourcing, candidate communication, reporting, and administrative workflows.
Continuously challenge the status quo by proposing creative, actionable ideas to smooth hiring bottlenecks, eliminate repetitive manual tasks, and elevate team efficiency.
EMEA Team Collaboration: Partner closely with regional Futureforce team members across EMEA, contributing to cross-border best practices, joint projects, and shared candidate pipelines.
Desired Skills & Experience
Education: Currently enrolled in a Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field, seeking a 6-month end-of-studies internship.
Languages: Bilingual or fluent in both French and English (written and verbal); able to engage candidates in French while collaborating seamlessly across global English-speaking teams.
AI Fluency & Innovation Mindset: Demonstrates genuine curiosity for AI technologies and everyday automation tools; eager to experiment with new ways of working and bring fresh ideas to optimise existing processes.
Attention to Detail & Compliance: Highly organised with a methodical approach to managing contractual processes, strict timelines, and legal paperwork.
Customer Centricity & Communication: Exceptional interpersonal, written, and presentation skills; comfortable acting as a professional and engaging ambassador for Salesforce.
Curiosity & Assessment Mindset: Naturally curious, enthusiastic about technology and learning recruitment methodologies, and skilled at assessing early-career talent against core competencies.
Proactivity & Adaptability: Self-starter with strong project management skills, able to juggle multiple deadlines and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment.
French version
Lieu : Paris, France
Type de contrat : Stage de 6 mois
Date de début : Février 2027
Exigence linguistique : Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais (écrit et oral obligatoire)
À propos de Futureforce
Futureforce est le programme mondial de recrutement universitaire de Salesforce, dédié à attirer, retenir et développer les talents de la prochaine génération. Nos stagiaires et jeunes diplômés travaillent sur des projets concrets qui ont un impact sur le fonctionnement de notre entreprise, leur offrant ainsi l’opportunité de faire une réelle différence pour l’avenir de Salesforce. Avec des bureaux dans le monde entier, nos recrues collaborent et se connectent à une véritable échelle internationale.
Nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire en recrutement universitaire, proactif(ve), très organisé(e) et orienté(e) client, pour rejoindre notre équipe pendant 6 mois à partir de février 2027. Dans ce rôle, vous accompagnerez le cycle complet de recrutement pour nos programmes d’alternance et de jeunes diplômés, défendrez notre marque employeur auprès des universités clés, veillerez à la conformité administrative et légale, et utiliserez des outils d’IA innovants pour optimiser nos processus.
Votre impact
Recrutement d’alternants et de jeunes diplômés :
Soutenir le recrutement de bout en bout des alternants et jeunes diplômés dans différentes entités de l’entreprise.
Collaborer avec les recruteurs pour examiner les candidatures, réaliser les premiers entretiens de présélection et coordonner les assessment centers.
Être l’ambassadeur(rice) des candidats, en assurant leur préparation, une communication claire et une expérience candidat remarquable.
Engagement campus & marque employeur :
Coordonner et participer à des événements de recrutement sur les campus ou en virtuel.
Conformité administrative & opérations :
Garantir la conformité administrative des embauches, gérer le processus des contrats d’alternance (CERFA/contrats), les soumissions OPCO et la paperasse obligatoire d’onboarding.
Assurer la rigueur opérationnelle, la précision du suivi et l’intégrité des données dans nos systèmes et outils RH internes.
Maîtrise de l’IA & innovation des processus :
Promouvoir la productivité grâce à l’IA : adopter les outils d’IA générative internes et émergents pour optimiser le sourcing, la communication avec les candidats, le reporting et les tâches administratives.
Remettre en question le statu quo en proposant des idées créatives et concrètes pour fluidifier les processus de recrutement, éliminer les tâches manuelles répétitives et améliorer l’efficacité de l’équipe.
Collaboration avec l’équipe EMEA :
Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les membres de l’équipe Futureforce dans la région EMEA, contribuer aux bonnes pratiques transfrontalières, aux projets communs et aux viviers de candidats partagés.
Compétences et expérience souhaitées
Formation : Actuellement en Master en Ressources Humaines, Administration des Affaires, Communication ou domaine similaire, à la recherche d’un stage de fin d’études de 6 mois.
Langues : Bilingue ou parfaitement à l’aise en français et en anglais (écrit et oral) ; capable d’échanger avec les candidats en français tout en collaborant efficacement avec des équipes internationales anglophones.
Maîtrise de l’IA & esprit d’innovation : Curiosité pour les technologies d’IA et les outils d’automatisation du quotidien ; envie d’expérimenter de nouvelles façons de travailler et d’apporter des idées innovantes pour optimiser les processus existants.
Rigueur & conformité : Très organisé(e), méthodique dans la gestion des processus contractuels, respect des délais stricts et des documents légaux.
Orientation client & communication : Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles, rédactionnelles et de présentation ; à l’aise pour représenter Salesforce de façon professionnelle et engageante.
Curiosité & évaluation : Naturellement curieux(se), passionné(e) par la technologie et l’apprentissage des méthodes de recrutement, capable d’évaluer les talents en début de carrière selon les compétences clés.
Proactivité & adaptabilité : Esprit d’initiative, solides compétences en gestion de projet, capacité à gérer plusieurs échéances et à s’adapter rapidement dans un environnement dynamique.
Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
Accommodations
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
Posting Statement
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

postings.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.
Job Category
Sales
Job Details
About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
The Enterprise Account Executive is part of Salesforce’s Enterprise Sales organization, supporting customers in Manufacturing, Automotive, Utilities, Travel& Transportation or Technology.
You will lead a focused portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts,. Working with senior customer executives and a cross-functional Salesforce account team, you will develop and execute account strategies that advance customers’ business priorities, accelerate digital transformation, and support their evolution toward an Agentic Enterprise—where people and trusted AI agents work together to drive measurable outcomes.
As both a strategic commercial leader and a technically fluent seller, you will connect business priorities with Salesforce’s platform, data, AI, integration, and cloud capabilities. You will be expected to lead credible conversations with business and technology executives, translate complex requirements into compelling solution strategies, and mobilize the right technical expertise throughout the sales cycle.
This role combines executive relationship leadership, consultative and technical selling, complex commercial execution, and cross-functional account orchestration.
What You’ll Do
Lead the account strategy: Develop and execute comprehensive, multi-year account plans aligned with customers’ strategic priorities, technology roadmaps, and Salesforce’s growth objectives.
Build executive relationships: Establish trusted-advisor relationships with C-level and senior business and technology leaders, bringing relevant industry insights, technical perspectives, and compelling points of view.
Drive business transformation: Translate customers’ business challenges and technology constraints into high-value platform, data, AI, and cloud strategies supported by clear business cases and measurable outcomes.
Lead business and technical discovery: Uncover customer objectives, business processes, architecture, data environment, integration requirements, security considerations, and transformation priorities. Identify gaps, dependencies, and potential barriers early in the sales cycle.
Shape the solution strategy and narrative: Partner with Solution Engineering, architects, and specialist teams to connect Salesforce capabilities to customer requirements and articulate how the proposed solution will deliver business and technical value.
Communicate across business and technology audiences: Make complex technology concepts accessible to business executives while clearly communicating business priorities, value drivers, and commercial implications to technical stakeholders.
Develop an Agentic Enterprise point of view: Help customers understand how trusted AI agents, unified data, automation, and human expertise can work together to transform customer and employee experiences.
Orchestrate the account team: Align Specialist Account Executives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, Professional Services, partners, and global system integrators around a unified customer and solution strategy.
Navigate complex sales cycles: Lead multi-stakeholder, multi-product enterprise opportunities from qualification and technical discovery through validation, negotiation, and close.
Required Qualifications
Demonstrated success in complex or enterprise software or SaaS sales, management consulting, technology consulting, or large-scale digital transformation.
Relevant experience in Manufacturing, Automotive, Utilities, Travel& Transportation or Technology and an understanding of its business models, operating challenges, technology landscape, and regulatory environment.
A track record of developing strategic enterprise accounts and meeting or exceeding significant revenue targets.
Experience leading complex, multi-year sales cycles involving multiple business units, senior executives, procurement teams, enterprise architects, security teams, and other technical stakeholders.
Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate effectively with C-level executives, operational leaders, and technical audiences.
Ability to develop credible perspectives on how data, AI, automation, and cloud platforms can enable business transformation.
Experience partnering with Solution Engineers, architects, product specialists, services teams, and implementation partners during technical evaluations.
Strong commercial judgment, negotiation skills, forecasting discipline, curiosity, and resilience.
Professional fluency in German and English, written and spoken, for customer and internal collaboration.
